domain_invariants.requirement: All resource ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive path resource ids are treated as not found, while non-positive body and query reference ids are validation errors.
Employees have unique employee_code, manager_employee_id, department 2..80, and active boolean.
Requests have inclusive date intervals in 2025-01-01..2035-12-31, 0.5..365 requested days, and DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED status.
An employee cannot have overlapping SUBMITTED or APPROVED requests of any leave type.
Only the active requester manager or admin may decide a SUBMITTED request; self-approval is prohibited.
Approval and rejection retain decided_at, decision_reason 3..500, and decider; terminal states are immutable.
Users see their own requests, managers see subordinate requests, and admins see all.
All lists use deterministic ascending immutable id pagination with limit 1..100 default 20 and after_id greater than zero, returning items and nullable next_after_id after filters.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; every other route requires a valid non-expired local Bearer session and is deny-by-default.
JSON writes require application/json; malformed JSON is 400, wrong media type is 415, and valid JSON violating declared fields is 422.
The API is local and deterministic with no network, filesystem, upload, or external service. 503 and 500 leave all persistent state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no authorization, accepting no input; it shall validate local persistence availability, probe only local persistence, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

    READ only authorized matching data; RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: persistent state unchanged and all errors have no effect.
